categories.evidence: Touches src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h with the RPC/REST/ZMQ label.
categories.rationale: Improves HTTP client disconnection logic and introduces deterministic unit tests for idle timeouts. The PR addresses follow-up review feedback from #35829 by replacing complex control flow in MaybeDisconnect with ShouldDisconnect, adding missing debug logs, and exercising disconnect paths using MockableSteadyClock in unit tests.
